menu:8019570:1.text: Paying top coin for fresh fish. Fair trade, no tricks!
menu:8019570:1.source_cn: 重金求购鲜鱼，童叟无欺。

menu:8019570:3.text: That was fast. Knew I could count on you!
menu:8019570:3.source_cn: 动作这么快，我果然没看错人！

say:1:1423410001:1.text: I've heard the Goodwill Market hasn't been very peaceful lately. Strange rumors are spreading, and some shady business is happening in secret.
say:1:1423410001:1.source_cn: 有消息称，最近蒙惠市集那边不太安定，有人在散布奇怪的流...

say:2:1423410002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I might need you to look into it. Sorry to trouble you again.
say:2:1423410002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I might need you to look into it. Sorry to trouble you again.
say:2:1423410002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I might need you to look into it. Sorry to trouble you again.

say:0:1423411001:0.text: Every stall is doing fine, except the one selling fish...
say:0:1423411001:0.source_cn: 除了那个卖鱼的摊位，别家生意都很好呢……

say:1:1423411002:0.text: Let's ask the fish vendor what's going on.
say:1:1423411002:0.source_cn: 要不我们去问问那个摊位的鱼贩？

say:2:1423412001:1.text: Hey, uh... is this a fish stall? Doesn't look like you've got many on display.
say:2:1423412001:1.source_cn: 老板，你这里……是在卖鱼吗？摆出来的鱼不是很多呢。

say:3:1423412002:1.text: Hehe, this stall buys and sells, same as any. I deal in rare fish, but stock's running low right now.
say:3:1423412002:1.source_cn: 呵呵，小店的生意，是有买有卖的。本店主营珍奇鱼种，既收...

say:4:1423412003:1.text: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?
say:4:1423412003:1.source_cn: 您是不是从别处得了点消息，想找我诚心做买卖？
say:4:1423412003:1.male: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?
say:4:1423412003:1.female: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?

choice_prompt:5:1423412003.text: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?
choice_prompt:5:1423412003.source_cn: 您是不是从别处得了点消息，想找我诚心做买卖？
choice_prompt:5:1423412003.male: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?
choice_prompt:5:1423412003.female: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?

say:6:1423412004:1.text: Great, then we're in business. I've been trying to get my hands on a fish called the Dew Cichlid. Bring me one, and I'll pay top coin. Don't worry about bait, I've got you covered!
say:6:1423412004:1.source_cn: 那就好办了。我这里正缺一种鱼，名叫柔露慈鲷，如果您能为...
say:6:1423412004:1.male: Great, then we're in business. I've been trying to get my hands on a fish called the Dew Cichlid. Bring me one, and I'll pay top coin. Don't worry about bait, I've got you covered!
say:6:1423412004:1.female: Great, then we're in business. I've been trying to get my hands on a fish called the Dew Cichlid. Bring me one, and I'll pay top coin. Don't worry about bait, I've got you covered!

say:8:1423412006:1.text: Not too bad... though the fishing spot is a bit of a pain. It's tucked away inside the Ebon Moon Palace. You'll have to get clever to reach it. Still, good pay for hard work. Seems fair, right?
say:8:1423412006:1.source_cn: 还好，还好……只是钓点的位置有点刁钻，在……晦月之殿里...

say:9:1423412007:1.text: If you're ready, come pick out your bait!
say:9:1423412007:1.source_cn: 如果您决定好的话，就来挑些鱼饵带走吧！
say:9:1423412007:1.male: If you're ready, come pick out your bait!
say:9:1423412007:1.female: If you're ready, come pick out your bait!

say:0:1423413001:0.text: The Dew Cichlid only appears in the <style="highlight">Ebon Moon Palace</style>. That's all I can tell you!
say:0:1423413001:0.source_cn: 柔露慈鲷只在<style=highlight>晦月之殿...
say:0:1423413001:0.male: The Dew Cichlid only appears in the <style="highlight">Ebon Moon Palace</style>. That's all I can tell you!
say:0:1423413001:0.female: The Dew Cichlid only appears in the <style="highlight">Ebon Moon Palace</style>. That's all I can tell you!

say:0:1423414001:0.text: Chippy doesn't see what's special about this fish...
say:0:1423414001:0.source_cn: 满满觉得这鱼也没什么特别的呀……

say:1:1423414002:0.text: Let's bring it back and see what the vendor has to say!
say:1:1423414002:0.source_cn: 回去找那个鱼贩看看他的反应吧！

say:2:1423415001:1.text: Here's the fish you asked for. Now, about our payment...
say:2:1423415001:1.source_cn: 你要的鱼钓回来啦！说好的重金求购！

say:3:1423415002:1.text: Of course. Fair trade. Take a look. Happy with the amount?
say:3:1423415002:1.source_cn: 当然，一手交钱一手交货嘛！您看看，这个数，满意吧？
say:3:1423415002:1.male: Of course. Fair trade. Take a look. Happy with the amount?
say:3:1423415002:1.female: Of course. Fair trade. Take a look. Happy with the amount?

choice_prompt:4:1423415002.text: Of course. Fair trade. Take a look. Happy with the amount?
choice_prompt:4:1423415002.source_cn: 当然，一手交钱一手交货嘛！您看看，这个数，满意吧？
choice_prompt:4:1423415002.male: Of course. Fair trade. Take a look. Happy with the amount?
choice_prompt:4:1423415002.female: Of course. Fair trade. Take a look. Happy with the amount?

say:5:1423415003:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，这下赚了，赚大发了！

say:6:1423415004:1.text: Wait a second... did we just undersell it?!
say:6:1423415004:1.source_cn: 这么说我们还卖便宜了？！

say:7:1423415005:1.text: That fish was raised in the Queen's own Divine Dew pool. Same stuff the nobles drink. They say its meat works like Divine Dew too!
say:7:1423415005:1.source_cn: 这可是被女王养在盛满灵露的池中，喝着灵露长大的鱼！据说...

say:8:1423415006:1.text: Didn't think you had it in you. You've got skills, just not much of a nose for pricing. But hey, if you're up for it, I'll be your regular buyer!
say:8:1423415006:1.source_cn: 没想到你们真有点本事，还不清楚市场价……交个朋友，我长...

say:12:1423415009:1.text: A deal's a deal. We caught the fish, and we're keeping the pay.
say:12:1423415009:1.source_cn: 说好了，钱我们可是不会退的，毕竟我们付出了劳动！

choice:10:0:1.text: It wasn't raised in Divine Dew.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 其实鱼不是被养在灵露池里的
choice:10:0:1.male: It wasn't raised in Divine Dew.
choice:10:0:1.female: It wasn't raised in Divine Dew.

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 这鱼和灵露一点关系都没有

choice:4:0:1.text: Give the fish to the vendor.
choice:4:0:1.male: Give the fish to the vendor.
choice:4:0:1.female: Give the fish to the vendor.

say:3:1423416002:1.text: It's amazing what someone with a bit of imagination can do with a plain little fish.
say:3:1423416002:1.source_cn: 原来那些不起眼的鱼在有心人看来还有这样的作用……如此丰...

say:4:1423416003:1.text: I'll send the guards to look into the vendor, his customers, and whoever's spreading rumors. You've done a great job!
say:4:1423416003:1.source_cn: 鱼贩曾经的顾客、向他散播谣言的人、还有鱼贩本人，我都会...
say:4:1423416003:1.male: I'll send the guards to look into the vendor, his customers, and whoever's spreading rumors. You've done a great job!
say:4:1423416003:1.female: I'll send the guards to look into the vendor, his customers, and whoever's spreading rumors. You've done a great job!

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: （讲述鱼贩收购柔露慈鲷的经过）
